caption: The drawing depicts a caricatured figure standing on a rectangular platform. The figure has dark brown skin, prominent red lips, large white teeth, and wide eyes, and is wearing a green suit with red trim and a yellow bowtie. A gray top hat is perched at an angle on the figure's head. The left arm is bent with a clenched fist, and the right arm is resting on a small stack of what looks like logs or wood with a metal handle attached. The platform is gray with faint lines to represent wooden planks, and the front panel is painted light red-orange with the words “STUMP SPEAKER” written in uppercase letters and outlined with yellow ornate decorations at the corners. The base of the platform is blue. There is a small artist's signature, "ALF BAUSENITH," in the bottom right corner of the drawing. The background is plain off-white.
title: Stump Speaker Bank
